description: This source file contains unit tests for the MenuSessionsInjector class in a macOS application. It tests menu item injection, session handling, and usage summaries related to the application's menu interface.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjectorTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the MenuSessionsInjector class, verifying menu item injections, session handling, and usage summary displays in a macOS application.

methods.name: anchorsDynamicRowsBelowControlsAndActions
methods.description: Tests whether the injector correctly finds the insert index below menu controls and actions.

methods.name: injectsDisconnectedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that a disconnected message can be injected into the menu when control channel is disconnected.

methods.name: injectsSessionRows
methods.description: Tests injection of session rows into the menu with various session data and usage summaries.

methods.name: cost usage submenu does not use injector delegate
methods.description: Ensures that the cost usage submenu is created without relying on the injector delegate.
